{{Quote|They're putting us through now. Ready to go live in five, four, three&hellip;|Unidentified Bothan communications officer|<ref name="Backlash" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] '''communications officer''' worked for [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]]. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], at the request of Daala, he contacted former [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Cha Niathal]]'s [[Cha Niathal's assistant|assistant]], who patched him through to Niathal. Daala then informed Niathal of her intentions to bring the former Admiral to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to stand trial, which resulted in Niathal committing [[Death/Legends|suicide]].
